nameEnOfficial: MSc in Asset Management and Maintenance (ODL)
sourceText: At the Master's programme in Asset Management and Maintenance, UTP invites forward-thinking managers from various engineering sectors and visionary plant managers to transform how industries manage assets, ensuring efficiency, reliability and safety remain at the forefront. Whether in manufacturing, power generation or any industry, the programme equips students with cutting-edge strategies and state-of-the-art technology to enhance the longevity and performance of critical machinery. Graduates with an MSc in Asset Management and Maintenance are positioned at the forefront of mechanical innovation.
